Name: Simple Ground Recolor
Author: EssGee
Description:
A simple recolor of mostly the ground, because I found the other recolor options I could find did "too much" for my taste. This recolor is designed for people who either like the vanilla trees and/or buildings, or are already using another replacement mod for those (for example, I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Foliage Redone- Foliage Only[/url]!) and just want something a little less saturated and less yellow-or-cyan for the ground.

I hope some of you will like it! :3
